notes.title: Demo Patch 0.4.2
notes.notes:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the player would slightly move when returning to the main menu from the introduction.
[*]Fixed a bug where Spikefly attacks wouldn't trigger a perfect dodge if the player was too high.
[*]Fixed a bug where the player could get repelled and locked until the next hit when jumping with a Boar slightly above their head.
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved Spikefly attack timing for more accurate counters using jump attacks.
[*]Refined repulsion behavior for Bunny, Boar, and Root Soldier.
[/list]
